==Description==
The '''Commander Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy that was released on 1st of July 2022, which was available to be pre-ordered until 22nd of May 2022. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 1 [[Commander]]. Anybody who bought the toy would be emailed a code 24 hours later, which allowed them to get the [[Commander/Gallery#Plushie|{{Color|Other|Plushie}} Commander]] skin. This is no longer the case after the 18th of May 2025.

It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton, it is 13 inches (33.03 cm) tall and 7.8 inches (19.812 cm) wide. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Commander Plushie'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:Check out our all new Commander Plush!
*'''Online (First)'''
*:Check out our all new Commander Plush! Every purchase comes with a free in-game skin. A redeemable gift code will be sent via email 24 hours after your purchase. 

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency.
The '''Commander Plush''' could have been purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $27.99. It is currently unavailable.

==Distribution==
The first plushies were distributed in late-June and started arriving to people in early July, depending on shipping times. Note that if you ordered later than the first day, shipping times would have varied wildly.
